notes: Experimental draft; no hardware-tested claim. Test individual functions in Profiler; Test All and automatic zoom discovery are unavailable for AW HTTP.
HTTP requires a numeric IPv4 camera address. HTTP only, no TLS or credential entry in v0.2.1. Authentication/access failures are reported; do not weaken camera security to test.
Preset buttons 1..100 encode decimal 00..99; no erase binding. Unsupported backlight, exposure compensation and white balance commands are omitted.
Normalized movement speeds map to AW speed magnitude 1..49 around STOP=50. Confirm directions and lens range on hardware.
At least 130 ms command gap enforced; default 150 ms. HTTP Connection: close. No automatic power-on, settings polling, command retry or preset writes on startup.
A preset acknowledgement does not indicate that movement has finished. The following zoom readback may be taken during travel. Emergency shutdown stops are best effort; verify physical STOP behavior.
